content: Inoupen Ipwidien Aisek
KAUN-O eri ketin pwarohng Eipraam ni tuhke sarawi kan en Mamre. Eipraam wie mwomwohd ni wenihmwen imwe impwalo ni ahnsou me karakar en rahn inenen laud.
Ih eri kilenglahte kilangada ohl silimen me kesikesihnen mwowe. Eri, ni ahnsowohte e tangalahng irail pwe en kasamwo irail. E ahpw poaridi lel nanpwel,
oh patohwan, “Maing ko, iet ngehi sapwellimamwail ladu, kumwail dehr douluhlweisang imweiet ahpw sohte kommoaldi.
I pahn wadohng kumwail pihl pwe kumwail en widen nehmwail kan; eri, kumwail kommoaldi mahs pahn mwetehn tuhkeht.

I pahn wiahda sakamwail, pwe kumwail en rosonda oh usehla amwail seiloaken. Kumwail leledohr ni imweiet; eri, I pahn papah kumwail.” Re ahpw sapeng, “Kalahngan en komwi; mehkoaros en wiawi duwen me komw mahsanih.”
Eipraam eri mwadangete patohlong nan impwalo oh ndahng Sara, “Mwadang umwunda pilawa, sang nan ehd en pilawa me keieu mwahu.”
Mwuri, e ahpw pil tangala rehn nah pelin kou ko oh pilada kou pwul me keieu pwulopwul oh mworourou, e ahpw kihong nah sounpapaho, pwe en pil kaunopada.
E pil ale pwete, milik, oh uduken kouo, oh kihong irail. Nindokon arail sakasak, Eipraam kesikesihnen mparail pahn tuhkeo.
Ni arail sakasak, re ahpw idek rehn Eipraam, “Ia Sara, omw pwoudo?” Eipraam ahpw sapeng, “E patopato nan impwalen.”

Emen irail ahpw mahsanih, “I inoukihong komwi me omwi pwoud Sara pahn naitikihada nah pwutak emen mwurin sounpwong 9, oh ni ahnsowo I pahn pwurodo.” Sara ahpw mihmi loale limwahn wenihmwen impwalo, rongorong mehkoaros.
Eipraam oh Sara ira inenen likeilapalahr, oh Sara solahr wia eh pwung.
Ihme e kouruhrkihda oh mengimengloalki, “Nan ei likeilapalahr oh solahr kak neitik, ia duwe, I pahn pil men wiewiahte nsenen pwopwoud? Oh ei pwoudo pil likeilapalahr mehlel.”
KAUN-O eri keinemwe rehn Eipraam, “Dahme Sara kouruhrki oh ndahki, ‘E pahn mehlel pwoat me I kak neitik nan ei likeilapalahr?’
Mie mehkot me apwal ong KAUN-O? Ni ahnsou me I kilelehdi, mwurin sounpwong 9, I pahn pwurodo rehmw oh Sara pahn naitikihada pwutak emen.”
Eri, pwehki Sara eh masepwehkada, e ahpw kahmahmkihla oh patohwan, “Soh! I sohte kouruhr.” KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanih, “Ei, ke kouruhrki.”
Eipraam Pekipeki Poadoarepen Sodom
Eri, ohlen keiru silimeno ahpw ketida oh ketiketlahng wasa kis me re kak iroirlahng kahnimw Sodom, oh Eipraam ahpw pil iangirailla pwe en kamwurirailla nanialo.
KAUN-O eri ketin mengimengloalki, “I sohte pahn ekihsang Eipraam dahme I pahn wiaht.
Kadaudoke kan pahn wiahla wehi lapalap oh manaman ehu, oh wehi koaros en sampah pahn peki I en kapaiairailda duwehte ei kapaiadahr ih.
I pilada ih pwe en padahkihong nah kan oh kadaudoke kan re en kin peikiong ei kosonned akan ni ar pahn kin wia dahme mwahu oh dahme pwung. I ahpw pahn kin kapwaiong ih soahng koaros me I inoukidahr.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Ngilen kedip ong Sodom oh Komora me inenen suwed, oh dipara kan me inenen toutou mehlel.
I pahn kohdihwei pwe I en kadehde ma ngilen kedip kan me I rongehr me mehlel de soh.”
Mehn keiru ko eri ketida oh ketiketlahng Sodom, a KAUN-O ketikette rehn Eipraam.
Eipraam eri keilahng mpen KAUN-O oh patohwanohng, “Ia duwe, komw uhdahn pahn ketin kamwomwala me dipan akan, iangahki me sohte dipe kan?
Ma mie aramas sohte dipe limehk nan kahnimwo, komw pahn ketin kamwomwala kahnimwo pwon? Komw sohte pahn kupwur mahk oh sohte ketin kamwomwala kahnimwo pwehki me lelepek limehko?

Eri, uhdahn soh! Komw sohte kak kemehla me dipan akan iangahki me sohte dipe kan. Met sohte kak wiawi rehmwi. Pwe ma met pahn pweida, me sohte dipe kan pahn ale lokolok duwehte me dipan akan. Met sohte kak wiawi. Sounkopwung en sampah pwon uhdahn pahn kin pwung ni sapwellime wiewia kan.”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma I pahn diar nan Sodom aramas limehk me sohte dipe, I pahn mahkohng kahnimwo unsek pwehki me limehko.”
Eipraam ahpw pil pwurehng patohwan, “Maing KAUN, komw ketin kupwur mahk oh kupwure ei pahn pwurehng pato. Aramas emen ngehi, me sohwar mehlel en patohwanda mehkot.

Ahpw ia duwe, mweinele aramas sohte dipe lelete pehklimmen, re sohte lel limehk. Komw pahn ketin kamwomwalahte kahnimwo pwon pwehki eh sohte lel limehko?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala kahnimwo, ma I diar aramas sohte dipe pehklimmen ie.”
Eipraam pil pwurehng patohwan, “A ma ele mehte pehk me dierek?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma mehte pehk me dierek ie.”

Eipraam ahpw patohwan, “Maing, komw dehpa engiengda pahi ma I pwurupwurehngete ei peidek kat. A ma mehte siliakan me dierekda?” KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma me siliakan dierekda.”

Eipraam ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketin kupwur mahk oh kupwure ei pahn pwurehng pato. A ma mehte riehk me dierekda?” KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, I sohte pahn kamwomwala kahnimwo ma I diar aramas sohte dipe riehk ie.”

Eipraam ahpw pil patohwanohng, “Maing, komw kupwur mahk, peidektehr ehu me I pahn wia. A ma mehte ehk me dierek nan kahnimwo?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I sohte pahn kamwomwala, ma me ehk dierekda.”
Mwurin KAUN-O eh mahseniong Eipraam, e ahpw ketiketla sang; a Eipraam ahpw pwuralahng ni imweo.
